desc: Identify the canonical route structure: mandatory/temporary off-flips followed by on-flips, with descending-cost off order and ascending-cost on order.
Derive the fixed-subset cost and the optional-selection objective, including mandatory-item contributions and interactions among selected optional bits.
Validate the corrected objective against the public samples and account for equal costs and optional common-one cycles.
Optimize optional-bit selection using suffixes of sorted optional costs with prefix sums and binary searches.
Implement the corrected \(O(N \log N)\) stdin/stdout Python solution and verify all three public samples.
